examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是都。
examples.trans: This is 都.

meanings.note: Short promotional preview of an upcoming show or film.

examples.text: 新节目的第一支预告片刚上线就登上了热搜榜。
examples.trans: The show's first trailer hit the trending chart right after release.

examples.text: 剪辑师花了一整周打磨这支两分钟的预告片。
examples.trans: The editor spent a full week polishing this two-minute trailer.

meanings.note: Used as resultative complement (买齐/到齐) meaning nothing missing.

examples.text: 单子上列的东西，我跑了好几趟全都给你买齐了。
examples.trans: After several trips, I bought every single item on your list.

examples.text: 参会人员都已经到齐了，咱们现在开始开会吧。
examples.trans: Everyone for the meeting is here—let us get started.
